documents.title: AURA Requirements (PRD excerpt)
chunks: AURA is a voice-first, action-oriented AI agent. It listens, plans, selects tools, executes approved actions, verifies results, updates memory, and responds by voice.
The data layer is JSON-file based behind a real API. The browser never reads or writes JSON files directly; it only talks to the store API.
Inference is local-first: provider interfaces allow swapping between deterministic offline planning and a local AMD ROCm runtime.

documents.title: AMD ROCm Blueprint notes
chunks: llama.cpp with ROCm/HIP serves Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-GGUF over an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
faster-whisper streams STT at 16 kHz; Piper or Kokoro generates streamed TTS chunks.
Environment probing reports GPU utilization and measured tokens/sec — numbers are never fabricated.
